facts.fact: DNI, a privately owned South African investment company, announced investments exceeding R2.1 billion in Frogfoot, Vox and Hypa, Mission Mobile and KnowRoaming; the commitment date is not stated, so the published date 2026-09-14 is used.
facts.system: DNI digital economy investments (Frogfoot, Vox/Hypa, Mission Mobile, KnowRoaming)

facts.fact: The DNI Consortium (DNI, Sabvest Capital, Masimong Group Holdings and Draper Gain International), South African investors, jointly hold 34.8% of Frogfoot and Vox after a capital raise valuing them at R14.4 billion; the date is not stated, so the published date 2026-09-14 is used.
